id: title:DanielVisca:surface insight alerts from the metrics ui

observations.behavior: Adds shared alert routing to existing saveAsInsightSuccess listener; no new backend or warehouse connector.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects metric query results to PostHog's Insight alerts page rather than building a separate Metrics-specific alert model.

observations.behavior: Reuses an unchanged previously saved insight for immediate alert setup without re-saving.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces redundant API calls while retaining compatibility with the shared Insights alert infrastructure.

observations.behavior: Suppresses duplicate toast notifications when either dashboard or alert flow is active and already routed onward.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves UX consistency by not showing conflicting success messages in flows that redirect immediately.

observations.limitations: All changes are confined to frontend TypeScript and tests. No implementation of actual alert configuration, threshold setting, delivery mechanism, or backend ingestion is shown. Tier cannot be raised above 2 because tier-3 requires demonstrated broader capability or systemic risk reduction across components, which this chunk does not establish.

review.limitations: All changes are confined to frontend TypeScript and tests. No implementation of actual alert configuration, threshold setting, delivery mechanism, or backend ingestion is shown. Tier cannot be raised above 2 because tier-3 requires demonstrated broader capability or systemic risk reduction across components, which this chunk does not establish.
review.reason: Adds bounded, localized behavior: shared alert routing and reuse within existing metrics viewer; no evidence of wider system impact or new critical-path reliability improvements.
review.posthog_relevance: Allows metric users to reach PostHog's Insight alerts page from a query result, potentially increasing adoption of shared alerting rather than requiring separate workflow.
review.uncertainty: Only frontend wiring and tests are supplied; unknown whether shared insight-alerts can support all required use cases without further backend work.
